notes: Ring-announcer read-outs for decisions (design v3: cards are read aloud). Show 'intro', then the result line for the decision type. Cards are pre-formatted from the WINNER's side, dissent listed as reversed (e.g. "28-29"); for draws use the order judges 1-3. titleSuffix.01 is for a new champion, .02 for a defense; append after the winner name in title fights. finishAnnouncement is for KO/TKO/submission results.

placeholders.totalRounds: Number of scheduled rounds, written as a number (3 or 5).
placeholders.winner: Winner's display name, with nickname, e.g. Dante "Sawblade" Okafor.
placeholders.time: Clock time of the finish on the 5:00 display, m:ss.

intro.text: Ladies and gentlemen, after {totalRounds} rounds, we go to the judges' scorecards.
We go to the scorecards for a decision.
Ladies and gentlemen, that's {totalRounds} rounds, and we have a decision.

unanimous.text: All three judges score the bout {card1}, {card2}, {card3}, for the winner by unanimous decision... {winner}!
{card1}, {card2}, and {card3}, for your winner by unanimous decision... {winner}!

split.text: {card1}, {card2}, {card3}, for the winner by split decision... {winner}!
We have a split decision. {card1}, {card2}, {card3}... your winner... {winner}!
Two judges to one. Split decision. Your winner... {winner}!

majority.text: {card1}, {card2}, {card3}, for the winner by majority decision... {winner}!
One judge scores it a draw, but the other two have a winner. By majority decision... {winner}!

unanimousDraw.text: All three judges score it {card1}, {card2}, {card3}. This bout is a unanimous draw!
{card1}, {card2}, {card3}. Ladies and gentlemen, we have a draw!

majorityDraw.text: {card1}, {card2}, {card3}. This bout is a majority draw!
Two judges see it even. This one is a majority draw!

splitDraw.text: {card1}, {card2}, {card3}. One judge for each fighter, one even. It's a split draw!
We have a split draw! Nobody leaves with the win tonight.

finishAnnouncement.text: Ladies and gentlemen, referee {refName} stops this contest at {time} of round {round}. Your winner by {method}... {winner}!
At {time} of round {round}, your winner by {method}... {winner}!
